//! What the schemas of `greeting show` accept and refuse.

use crate::cases::{Case, Expect, Word, run};

type Input = Vec<&'static str>;
type Value = ();
type Failure = ();

/// The rows of the accepted and the refused command lines.
const CASES: &[Case<Input, Value, Failure>] = &[
    Case {
        name: "the command line is accepted",
        word: Word::Succeeds,
        input: || vec!["show"],
        expect: Expect::Value(()),
    },
];

/// Checks one command line through the schemas.
fn subject(line: Input) -> Result<Value, Failure> {
    todo!("convert the command line into the core's types")
}

#[test]
fn succeeds() {
    run(CASES, Word::Succeeds, subject);
}
